info.name: Express-Api
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the movies API. Run the folders in order (Auth, Movies, Users).

The admin-only requests need an existing admin account: set the `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` collection variables. Signup always creates a normal user, so promote one in MongoDB first: `db.users.updateOne({email:'...'},{$set:{role:'admin'}})`.

exec: pm.test("role cannot be set by the client", () => pm.expect(json.data.user.role).to.eql("user"));
pm.test("default page size is at most 10", () => pm.expect(json.length).to.be.at.most(10));
pm.test("returns at least one movie", () => pm.expect(movies.length).to.be.above(0));
pm.test("every movie is rated 4.5 or more", () => movies.forEach((m) => pm.expect(m.ratings).to.be.at.least(4.5)));
